text.p: Cosmopolitan Magazine launched a Polish edition on Tuesday with an issue of 200,000 copies -- the 31st national edition of the U.S. women's monthly.
George Green, the president of the magazine's co-publisher Hearst Magazines International, told a news conference the issue had 40 pages of advertising.
He declined to say when the publication was expected to break even.

Elzbieta Smolenska, the editor of the Polish edition, also present, said the new publication expected to attract advertising from international and Polish producers of cosmetics, household appliances, cars and fashion clothing.
Cosmopolitan will be published in Poland by a 50-50 joint venture of Hearst Magazines International and Swiss publisher Juerg Marquard which now publishes four magazines for teenagers in the country.
The largest-circulation women's magazine in Poland now is Twoj Styl (Your Style) with 450,000 copies, while Elle has 150,000 copies. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
